flows.name: SQL 생성(발생)
flows.func:
msg.payload = `
INSERT INTO tb_equipment_alarm_report (
    alarm_start_time,
    tagsn,
    sitename,
    facilitytype,
    equipmenttype,
    alarm_msg,
    alarm_status,
    alarm_category,
    alarm_value,
    tagtype,
    is_false_alarm,
    false_alarm_notes
)
SELECT
    r.logtime AS alarm_start_time,
    ti.tagsn,
    ti.sitename,
    ti.facilitytype,
    ti.equipmenttype,
    ti.datadesc AS alarm_msg,
    '진행중' AS alarm_status,

    CASE
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%펌프%' THEN '펌프'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%탁도%' OR ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%수질%' THEN '수질'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%밸브%' THEN '밸브'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%수위%' THEN '수위'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%압력%' THEN '압력'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%UPS%' THEN 'UPS'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%네트워크%' THEN '네트워크'
        WHEN ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%유량%' THEN '유량'
        ELSE '기타'
    END AS alarm_category,

    r.val AS alarm_value,
    ti.tagtype,
    'N' AS is_false_alarm,
    '정상 알람' AS false_alarm_notes

FROM tb_tag_info ti
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.val, r.logtime
    FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
    WHERE r.tagsn = ti.tagsn
    ORDER BY r.logtime DESC
    LIMIT 1
) r ON TRUE

WHERE ti.alarm_tag_yn = 1
  AND r.val = 1

  /* ① 이미 진행 중인 알람이 있으면 신규 발생 금지 */
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM tb_equipment_alarm_report ar
      WHERE ar.tagsn = ti.tagsn
        AND ar.alarm_end_time IS NULL
  )

  /* ② Task 기반 알람 필터링 기간이면 발생하지 */
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM tb_task_master tm
      WHERE tm.sitename = ti.sitename
        AND tm.facilitytype = ti.facilitytype
        AND tm.task_start_time <= r.logtime
        AND (tm.task_end_time IS NULL OR tm.task_end_time >= r.logtime)

        /* suspend_alarm_types(JSONB) → equipmenttype 매핑 */
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(tm.suspend_alarm_types) = 'array'
                    THEN tm.suspend_alarm_types
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END
            ) AS sat(type)
            WHERE
                sat.type = '전체'
             OR (sat.type = '유량'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%유량%')
             OR (sat.type = '수위'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%수위%')
             OR (sat.type = '네트워크' AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%네트워크%')
             OR (sat.type = '통신'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%네트워크%')
             OR (sat.type = '펌프'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%펌프%')
             OR (sat.type = '밸브'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%밸브%')
             OR (sat.type = '압력'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%압력%')
             OR (sat.type = '수질'     AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%수질%')
             OR (sat.type = 'UPS'      AND ti.equipmenttype ILIKE '%UPS%')
             OR sat.type = ti.datadesc
             OR sat.type = ti.datainfo
        )
  );
`;
return msg;

flows.func:
/*
목적:
- sitename / facilitytype 기준
- 압력계(Analog Input) 태그 조회
- 현재 압력 vs
  ① 데이터가 존재하는 최근 1개월 최고 압력
  ② 데이터가 존재하는 최근 1개월 최저 압력 비교

입력:
- msg.payload.sitename
- msg.payload.facilitytype

출력:
- msg.payload : SQL 문자열
*/

let item = msg.payload;

let sitename = item.sitename;
let facilitytype = item.facilitytype;

msg.sitename = item.sitename;
msg.facilitytype = item.facilitytype;
msg.alarm_msg = item.alarm_msg;



// 필수 파라미터 체크
if (!sitename || !facilitytype) {
    node.warn("sitename or facilitytype missing");
    msg.payload = null;
    return msg;
}

// SQL 생성
msg.payload = `
WITH pressure_tags AS (
    SELECT tagsn
    FROM tb_tag_info
    WHERE sitename = '${sitename}'
      AND facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
      AND equipmenttype = '압력계'
      AND tagtype = 'Analog Input'
      AND (
            datainfo  ~* '유출|토출|압력'
         OR datadesc ~* '유출|토출|압력'
      )
),

current_pressure AS (
    -- 태그별 최신 압력
    SELECT
        t.tagsn,
        r.val AS current_val
    FROM pressure_tags t
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT val
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data
        WHERE tagsn = t.tagsn
        ORDER BY logtime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON true
),

latest_cagg_day AS (
    -- tagsn별 CAGG 최신 날짜
    SELECT
        tagsn,
        MAX(bucket) AS last_bucket
    FROM cagg_daily_pressure
    WHERE tagsn IN (SELECT tagsn FROM pressure_tags)
    GROUP BY tagsn
),

month_pressure_range AS (
    -- 데이터가 존재하는 최근 1개월 기준 압력 범위
    SELECT
        c.tagsn,
        MAX(c.max_val) AS month_max_val,
        MIN(c.min_val) AS month_min_val
    FROM cagg_daily_pressure c
    JOIN latest_cagg_day l
      ON c.tagsn = l.tagsn
     AND c.bucket >= l.last_bucket - interval '1 month'
     AND c.bucket <= l.last_bucket
    GROUP BY c.tagsn
)

SELECT
    cp.tagsn,
    ROUND(cp.current_val, 2)        AS current_val,
    ROUND(r.month_max_val, 2)       AS month_max_val,
    ROUND(r.month_min_val, 2)       AS month_min_val,

    -- 고압 판단
    CASE
        WHEN r.month_max_val IS NULL THEN false
        WHEN cp.current_val > r.month_max_val THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS is_higher_than_month_max,

    -- 저압 판단
    CASE
        WHEN r.month_min_val IS NULL THEN false
        WHEN cp.current_val < r.month_min_val THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS is_lower_than_month_min

FROM current_pressure cp
LEFT JOIN month_pressure_range r
  ON cp.tagsn = r.tagsn
`;

return msg;

- msg.payload.sitename
- msg.payload.facilitytype

출력:
- msg.payload : SQL 문자열
*/

let item = msg.payload;

let sitename = item.sitename;
let facilitytype = item.facilitytype;

msg.facilitytype = item.facilitytype;
msg.alarm_msg = item.alarm_msg;

// 필수 파라미터 체크
if (!sitename || !facilitytype) {
    node.warn("sitename or facilitytype missing");
    msg.payload = null;
    return msg;
}

// SQL 생성
msg.payload = `
WITH pressure_tags AS (
    SELECT tagsn
    FROM tb_tag_info
    WHERE sitename = '${sitename}'
      AND facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
      AND equipmenttype = '압력계'
      AND tagtype = 'Analog Input'
      AND (
            datainfo  ~* '유출|토출|압력'
         OR datadesc ~* '유출|토출|압력'
      )
),

current_pressure AS (
    -- 태그별 최신 압력
    SELECT
        t.tagsn,
        r.val AS current_val
    FROM pressure_tags t
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT val
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data
        WHERE tagsn = t.tagsn
        ORDER BY logtime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON true
),

latest_cagg_day AS (
    -- tagsn별 CAGG 최신 날짜
    SELECT
        tagsn,
        MAX(bucket) AS last_bucket
    FROM cagg_daily_pressure
    WHERE tagsn IN (SELECT tagsn FROM pressure_tags)
    GROUP BY tagsn
),

month_pressure_range AS (
    -- 데이터가 존재하는 최근 1개월 기준 압력 범위
    SELECT
        c.tagsn,
        MAX(c.max_val) AS month_max_val,
        MIN(c.min_val) AS month_min_val
    FROM cagg_daily_pressure c
    JOIN latest_cagg_day l
      ON c.tagsn = l.tagsn
     AND c.bucket >= l.last_bucket - interval '1 month'
     AND c.bucket <= l.last_bucket
    GROUP BY c.tagsn
)

SELECT
    cp.tagsn,
    ROUND(cp.current_val, 2)        AS current_val,
    ROUND(r.month_max_val, 2)       AS month_max_val,
    ROUND(r.month_min_val, 2)       AS month_min_val,

    -- 고압 판단
    CASE
        WHEN r.month_max_val IS NULL THEN false
        WHEN cp.current_val > r.month_max_val THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS is_higher_than_month_max,

    -- 저압 판단
    CASE
        WHEN r.month_min_val IS NULL THEN false
        WHEN cp.current_val < r.month_min_val THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS is_lower_than_month_min

FROM current_pressure cp
LEFT JOIN month_pressure_range r
  ON cp.tagsn = r.tagsn
`;

return msg;

let sql = `
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        r.logtime,
        r.val::numeric AS val,
        i.sitename,
        i.facilitytype,
        r.tagsn,
        lag(r.val::numeric, 1) OVER w AS prev_val,
        lag(r.val::numeric, 2) OVER w AS prev2_val
    FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
    JOIN tb_tag_info i ON i.tagsn = r.tagsn
    WHERE i.equipmenttype = '압력계'
      AND i.sitename = '${msg.sitename}'
      AND i.facilitytype = '${msg.facilitytype}'
      AND r.val IS NOT NULL
      AND r.logtime >= now() - interval '10 minute'
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY r.tagsn ORDER BY r.logtime)
),
calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        (val - prev_val) AS dp,
        (prev_val - prev2_val) AS dq,
        CASE
            WHEN prev2_val IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN SIGN(val - prev_val) <> SIGN(prev_val - prev2_val) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS sign_flip
    FROM base
    WHERE prev_val IS NOT NULL
),
flip3 AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(sign_flip) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tagsn
            ORDER BY logtime
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '3 minute' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS flip_cnt_3min
    FROM calc
),
hunting AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN dq IS NOT NULL
             AND ABS(dq) > 1e-9
             AND ABS(dp / dq) >= 3
             AND flip_cnt_3min >= 5
            THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_pressure_hunting
    FROM flip3
    WHERE logtime >= now() - interval '4 minute'
)
SELECT * FROM hunting
WHERE is_pressure_hunting = true
ORDER BY tagsn, logtime;
`;
msg.payload = sql;
return msg;

전체 파라미터 수집 쿼리 (v2)
flows.func:
// 전체 파라미터 수집 CTE 쿼리 (v2 - DB 태그 패턴 반영)
// 변경: 동작/운전/RUN 3키워드, pump_mode DI태그, inlet_valve equipmenttype, SET 패턴
let sitename = msg.sitename;
let facilitytype = msg.facilitytype;

msg.payload = `
WITH
-- 1) 타설비 가동 여부: 같은 가압장의 펌프 동작(운전/RUN/동작) 태그 확인
other_pump AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tb_tag_info i
        JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
            WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
            ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
        ) r ON true
        WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
          AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
          AND i.equipmenttype ~ '가압펌프'
          AND (i.datainfo ~* '운전|동작' OR i.datadesc ~* 'RUN|동작')
          AND NOT i.datainfo ~* 'FAULT|FLT|STOP|정지'
          AND i.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
          AND r.val::int = 1
    ) AS other_facility_running
),

-- 2) 통신 ping 상태
comm_status AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT CASE WHEN ns.is_alive = 'True' THEN 'normal' ELSE 'abnormal' END
         FROM tb_network_status ns
         WHERE ns.ip_address IN (
             SELECT DISTINCT ti2.ip_address FROM tb_tag_info ti2
             WHERE ti2.sitename = '${sitename}'
               AND ti2.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
               AND ti2.ip_address IS NOT NULL
         )
         ORDER BY ns.check_time DESC LIMIT 1),
        'normal'
    ) AS comm_ping_status
),

-- 3) 펌프 운전 모드 (auto/manual) - DI 태그 기반
-- DB패턴: "가압펌프 자동", "가압펌프#1 자동", "가압펌프#1 AUTO", "펌프1호_자동", "펌프#1 AT"
pump_mode AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT CASE WHEN r.val::int = 1 THEN 'auto' ELSE 'manual' END
         FROM tb_tag_info i
         JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
             WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
             ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
         ) r ON true
         WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
           AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
           AND i.equipmenttype ~ '가압펌프'
           AND (i.datainfo ~* '자동|AUTO' OR i.datadesc ~* '자동|AUTO|AT')
           AND i.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
         LIMIT 1),
        'auto'
    ) AS pump_mode_status
),

-- 4) 펌프 가동조건 SET 태그 확인
-- DB패턴: "HH SET", "LL SET", "H SET", "L SET", "압력 SET"
run_condition AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tb_tag_info i
        JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
            WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
            ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
        ) r ON true
        WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
          AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
          AND i.tagtype = 'Analog Output'
          AND (i.datainfo ~* 'SET|설정')
          AND r.val IS NOT NULL
          AND r.val::numeric > 0
    ) AS pump_run_condition_met
),

-- 5) 펌프 FAULT 여부
-- DB패턴: "가압펌프1 FAULT", "인버터1 FAULT", datadesc: "FLT", "FAULT", "INV FLT"
fault_check AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tb_tag_info i
        JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
            WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
            ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
        ) r ON true
        WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
          AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
          AND i.equipmenttype ~ '가압펌프'
          AND (i.datainfo ~* 'FLT|FAULT|고장' OR i.datadesc ~* 'FLT|FAULT')
          AND i.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
          AND r.val::int = 1
    ) AS pump_fault
),

-- 6) 흡수정 존재 여부
-- DB패턴: equipmenttype='흡수정밸브', datainfo='흡수정 수위', equipmenttype='수위계'+datainfo~'흡수정'
intake_well AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tb_tag_info
        WHERE sitename = '${sitename}'
          AND facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
          AND (datainfo ~* '흡수정' OR equipmenttype ~* '흡수정')
    ) AS intake_well_exists
),

-- 7) 컨트롤러 통신상태
controller_comm AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT CASE WHEN ns.is_alive = 'True' THEN 'normal' ELSE 'abnormal' END
         FROM tb_network_status ns
         WHERE ns.ip_address IN (
             SELECT DISTINCT ti2.ip_address FROM tb_tag_info ti2
             WHERE ti2.sitename = '${sitename}'
               AND ti2.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
               AND ti2.ip_address IS NOT NULL
         )
         ORDER BY ns.check_time DESC LIMIT 1),
        'normal'
    ) AS controller_comm_status
),

-- 8) 흡수정 수위 레벨 (LL 판정)
-- DB패턴: equipmenttype='수위계', datainfo='흡수정 수위' (AI) / '흡수정 수위 LL 알람 발생' (DI)
intake_level AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        -- 먼저 DI 태그(LL 알람 발생)로 확인
        (SELECT CASE WHEN r.val::int = 1 THEN 'LL' ELSE 'normal' END
         FROM tb_tag_info i
         JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
             WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
             ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
         ) r ON true
         WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
           AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
           AND i.datainfo ~* '흡수정.*LL'
           AND i.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
         LIMIT 1),
        -- AI 태그(수위값)로 LL SET값과 비교
        (SELECT CASE
            WHEN AVG(r.val::numeric) <= COALESCE(
                (SELECT r2.val::numeric FROM tb_tag_info i2
                 JOIN LATERAL (
                     SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r2
                     WHERE r2.tagsn = i2.tagsn
                     ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
                 ) r2 ON true
                 WHERE i2.sitename = '${sitename}'
                   AND i2.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
                   AND i2.datainfo ~* 'LL.*SET|LL.*설정'
                   AND i2.tagtype = 'Analog Output'
                 LIMIT 1), 0)
            THEN 'LL'
            ELSE 'normal'
         END
         FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
         JOIN tb_tag_info i ON i.tagsn = r.tagsn
         WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
           AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
           AND i.datainfo ~* '흡수정.*수위'
           AND i.tagtype = 'Analog Input'
           AND r.logtime >= now() - interval '5 minutes'
        ),
        'normal'
    ) AS intake_well_level
),

-- 9) 유입밸브 상태
-- DB패턴: equipmenttype='유입밸브', FULL OPEN(F_OPEN)/FULL CLOSE(F_CLOSE)
inlet_valve AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        -- FULL CLOSE 태그 확인: val=1이면 closed
        (SELECT CASE WHEN r.val::int = 1 THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END
         FROM tb_tag_info i
         JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
             WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
             ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
         ) r ON true
         WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
           AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
           AND i.equipmenttype = '유입밸브'
           AND (i.datainfo ~* 'FULL CLOSE|F_CLOSE' OR i.datadesc ~* 'F_CLOSE|FULL CLOSE')
           AND i.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
         LIMIT 1),
        'open'
    ) AS inlet_valve_status
),

-- 10) 밸브 설정 모드 (auto/manual)
-- DB패턴: equipmenttype='유입밸브'+'원격'(REMOTE) → auto, 없으면 manual
valve_mode AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT CASE WHEN r.val::int = 1 THEN 'auto' ELSE 'manual' END
         FROM tb_tag_info i
         JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT val FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
             WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
             ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 1
         ) r ON true
         WHERE i.sitename = '${sitename}'
           AND i.facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
           AND i.equipmenttype ~ '밸브'
           AND (i.datainfo ~* '원격|자동|AUTO' OR i.datadesc ~* 'REMOTE|AUTO|AT|자동')
           AND i.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
         LIMIT 1),
        'auto'
    ) AS booster_valve_mode
),

-- 11) 전단시설 종류
upstream AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(f.upstream_sitename, '') AS upstream_sitename,
        COALESCE(f.upstream_facilitytype, '') AS upstream_facilitytype
    FROM tb_facility_flow_map f
    WHERE f.downstream_sitename = '${sitename}'
      AND f.downstream_facilitytype = '${facilitytype}'
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    op.other_facility_running,
    cs.comm_ping_status,
    pm.pump_mode_status,
    rc.pump_run_condition_met,
    fc.pump_fault,
    iw.intake_well_exists,
    cc.controller_comm_status,
    il.intake_well_level,
    iv.inlet_valve_status,
    vm.booster_valve_mode,
    u.upstream_sitename,
    u.upstream_facilitytype
FROM other_pump op, comm_status cs, pump_mode pm, run_condition rc,
     fault_check fc, intake_well iw, controller_comm cc, intake_level il,
     inlet_valve iv, valve_mode vm, upstream u;
`;

return msg;

flows.name: HH,LL 설정값 업데이트
flows.func:
let sql = `
UPDATE tb_service_reservoir_status s
SET
    alarm_high_water_level = calc.hh_level,
    alarm_low_water_level  = calc.ll_level,
    last_updated_at        = now()
FROM (

    SELECT
        ti.sitename,

        /* HH 우선, 없으면 H */
        COALESCE(

            /* HH */
            MAX(CASE 
                WHEN ti.datainfo ~* '(^|[^A-Z])HH([^A-Z]|$)'
                 AND r.val > 0
                THEN r.val
            END),

            /* H (fallback) */
            MAX(CASE 
                WHEN ti.datainfo ~* '(^|[^A-Z])H([^A-Z]|$)'
                 AND r.val > 0
                THEN r.val
            END)

        ) AS hh_level,

        /* LL 우선, 없으면 L */
        COALESCE(

            /* LL */
            MIN(CASE 
                WHEN ti.datainfo ~* '(^|[^A-Z])LL([^A-Z]|$)'
                 AND r.val > 0
                THEN r.val
            END),

            /* L (fallback) */
            MIN(CASE 
                WHEN ti.datainfo ~* '(^|[^A-Z])L([^A-Z]|$)'
                 AND r.val > 0
                THEN r.val
            END)

        ) AS ll_level

    FROM tb_tag_info ti

    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT val
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        WHERE r.tagsn = ti.tagsn
        ORDER BY r.logtime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON TRUE

    WHERE ti.facilitytype = '배수지'
      AND ti.equipmenttype = '수위계'
      AND ti.tagtype = 'Analog Output'

    GROUP BY ti.sitename

) calc
WHERE s.sitename = calc.sitename;

`

return msg;

flows.name: 용수공급가능시간
flows.func:
let sql = `

UPDATE tb_service_reservoir_status s
SET
    total_supply_time = calc.total_supply_time,
    supply_time_status = calc.status_code,
    supply_time_reason = calc.status_reason,
    last_updated_at = now()

FROM (

    /* ===============================
       1️⃣ 유출 적산 태그 존재 여부
    =============================== */
    WITH tag_check AS (
        SELECT
            ti.sitename,
            COUNT(*) AS tag_count
        FROM tb_tag_info ti
        WHERE ti.facilitytype = '배수지'
          AND ti.datainfo LIKE '%유출%적산%'
        GROUP BY ti.sitename
    ),

    /* ===============================
       2️⃣ 유출 적산 (태그별 delta → 합산)
    =============================== */
    outflow_tag_delta AS (
        SELECT
            ti.sitename,
            ti.tagsn,
            MAX(r.val) - MIN(r.val) AS delta
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        JOIN tb_tag_info ti ON ti.tagsn = r.tagsn
        WHERE ti.facilitytype = '배수지'
          AND ti.datainfo LIKE '%유출%적산%'
          AND r.logtime >= date_trunc('day', now())
        GROUP BY ti.sitename, ti.tagsn
    ),

    outflow_delta AS (
        SELECT
            sitename,
            SUM(delta) AS delta
        FROM outflow_tag_delta
        GROUP BY sitename
    ),

    /* ===============================
       3️⃣ 유입 적산 (태그별 delta → 합산)
    =============================== */
    inflow_tag_delta AS (
        SELECT
            ti.sitename,
            ti.tagsn,
            MAX(r.val) - MIN(r.val) AS delta
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        JOIN tb_tag_info ti ON ti.tagsn = r.tagsn
        WHERE ti.facilitytype = '배수지'
          AND ti.datainfo LIKE '%유입%적산%'
          AND r.logtime >= date_trunc('day', now())
        GROUP BY ti.sitename, ti.tagsn
    ),

    inflow_delta AS (
        SELECT
            sitename,
            SUM(delta) AS delta
        FROM inflow_tag_delta
        GROUP BY sitename
    ),

    /* ===============================
       4️⃣ 오늘 경과 시간
    =============================== */
    runtime AS (
        SELECT
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - date_trunc('day', now())) / 3600 AS hours_elapsed
    )

    SELECT
        i.sitename,

        /* ===============================
           🔵 공급가능시간 계산
           net = outflow - inflow
           net <= 0 → 24시간 고정
        =============================== */
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN tc.tag_count IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN od.delta IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN s.current_water_level IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN rt.hours_elapsed <= 0 THEN NULL

                WHEN ((od.delta / rt.hours_elapsed)
                    - COALESCE(id.delta,0) / rt.hours_elapsed) <= 0
                THEN 24

                ELSE
                (
                    (
                        (
                            COALESCE(i.zone_1_area,0) +
                            COALESCE(i.zone_2_area,0) +
                            COALESCE(i.zone_3_area,0) +
                            COALESCE(i.zone_4_area,0) +
                            COALESCE(i.zone_5_area,0)
                        )
                        * s.current_water_level
                    )
                    /
                    (
                        (od.delta / rt.hours_elapsed)
                        - COALESCE(id.delta,0) / rt.hours_elapsed
                    )
                )
            END
        ,2) AS total_supply_time  ,


        /* ===============================
           🔵 상태 코드
        =============================== */
        CASE
            WHEN tc.tag_count IS NULL THEN 'NOT_CONFIGURED'
            WHEN od.delta IS NULL THEN 'NO_OUTFLOW_DATA'
            WHEN s.current_water_level IS NULL THEN 'NO_LEVEL'
            WHEN rt.hours_elapsed <= 0 THEN 'TIME_ERROR'
            WHEN ((od.delta / rt.hours_elapsed)
                  - COALESCE(id.delta,0) / rt.hours_elapsed) <= 0
            THEN 'CHARGING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL'
        END AS status_code,


        /* ===============================
           🔵 상태 설명
        =============================== */
        CASE
            WHEN tc.tag_count IS NULL THEN '유출 적산 태그 미구축'
            WHEN od.delta IS NULL THEN '오늘 유출 데이터 없음'
            WHEN s.current_water_level IS NULL THEN '현재 수위 데이터 없음'

    GROUP BY t.sitename
),

-- 최근 5분 현재 가동
current_pump AS (
    SELECT
        sub.sitename,
        COUNT(*) AS running_pump_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.sitename, r.tagsn)
               t.sitename,
               r.tagsn,
               r.val
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        JOIN tb_tag_info t ON r.tagsn = t.tagsn

          AND t.datainfo LIKE '%동작%'
          AND t.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
          AND r.logtime >= now() - interval '5 minutes'
        ORDER BY t.sitename, r.tagsn, r.logtime DESC
    ) sub
    WHERE sub.val = 1
    GROUP BY sub.sitename
),

-- 유입(흡입) 압력 최근 10분 대표 1건

      AND r.logtime > now() - interval '10 minutes'
      AND r.val > 0
      AND r.tag_stat = 'GOOD!!'
    ORDER BY t.sitename, r.logtime DESC
),

-- 토출(유출) 압력 최근 10분 대표 1건
outlet_pressure AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.sitename)
           t.sitename,
           r.val
    FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
    JOIN tb_tag_info t ON r.tagsn = t.tagsn

      AND r.logtime > now() - interval '10 minutes'

    FROM cagg_daily_pressure c
    JOIN tb_tag_info t ON c.tagsn = t.tagsn
    WHERE t.facilitytype = '가압장'

            JOIN tb_tag_info t2 ON c2.tagsn = t2.tagsn
            WHERE t2.facilitytype = '가압장'

      AND t.datainfo NOT LIKE '%알람%'

    GROUP BY t.sitename

SET booster_inlet_pressure        = COALESCE(ip.val,0),
    booster_outlet_pressure       = COALESCE(op.val,0),
    booster_avg_pressure          = COALESCE(pa.booster_avg_pressure,0),
    running_pump_count            = COALESCE(cp.running_pump_count,0),
    normal_operation_pump_count   = COALESCE(np.normal_operation_pump_count,0)

LEFT JOIN normal_pump np ON sl.sitename = np.sitename
LEFT JOIN current_pump cp ON sl.sitename = cp.sitename
LEFT JOIN inlet_pressure ip ON sl.sitename = ip.sitename
LEFT JOIN outlet_pressure op ON sl.sitename = op.sitename
LEFT JOIN pressure_avg pa ON sl.sitename = pa.sitename
WHERE s.sitename = sl.sitename;
`;

return msg;

let sql = `
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        r.logtime,
        r.val::numeric AS val,
        i.sitename,
        i.facilitytype,
        r.tagsn,
        lag(r.val::numeric, 1) OVER w AS prev_val,
        lag(r.val::numeric, 2) OVER w AS prev2_val
    FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
    JOIN tb_tag_info i ON i.tagsn = r.tagsn
    WHERE i.equipmenttype = '수위계'
      AND i.sitename = '${msg.sitename}'

      AND r.val IS NOT NULL
      AND r.logtime >= now() - interval '10 minute'
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY r.tagsn ORDER BY r.logtime)
),
calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        (val - prev_val) AS dp,
        (prev_val - prev2_val) AS dq,
        CASE
            WHEN prev2_val IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN SIGN(val - prev_val) <> SIGN(prev_val - prev2_val) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS sign_flip
    FROM base
    WHERE prev_val IS NOT NULL
),
flip3 AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(sign_flip) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tagsn
            ORDER BY logtime
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '3 minute' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS flip_cnt_3min
    FROM calc
),
hunting AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN dq IS NOT NULL
             AND ABS(dq) > 1e-9
             AND ABS(dp / dq) >= 3
             AND flip_cnt_3min >= 5
            THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_level_hunting
    FROM flip3
    WHERE logtime >= now() - interval '4 minute'
)
SELECT * FROM hunting
WHERE is_level_hunting = true
ORDER BY tagsn, logtime;
`;
msg.payload = sql;
return msg;

let sql = `
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        r.logtime,
        r.val::numeric AS val,
        i.sitename,
        i.facilitytype,
        r.tagsn,
        lag(r.val::numeric, 1) OVER w AS prev_val,
        lag(r.val::numeric, 2) OVER w AS prev2_val
    FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
    JOIN tb_tag_info i ON i.tagsn = r.tagsn
    WHERE i.equipmenttype = '압력계'
      AND i.sitename = '${msg.sitename}'
      AND i.facilitytype = '${msg.facilitytype}'
      AND r.val IS NOT NULL
      AND r.logtime >= now() - interval '10 minute'
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY r.tagsn ORDER BY r.logtime)
),
calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        (val - prev_val) AS dp,
        (prev_val - prev2_val) AS dq,
        CASE
            WHEN prev2_val IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN SIGN(val - prev_val) <> SIGN(prev_val - prev2_val) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS sign_flip
    FROM base
    WHERE prev_val IS NOT NULL
),
flip3 AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(sign_flip) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tagsn
            ORDER BY logtime
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '3 minute' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS flip_cnt_3min
    FROM calc
),
hunting AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN dq IS NOT NULL
             AND ABS(dq) > 1e-9
             AND ABS(dp / dq) >= 3
             AND flip_cnt_3min >= 5
            THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_pressure_hunting
    FROM flip3
    WHERE logtime >= now() - interval '4 minute'
)
SELECT * FROM hunting
WHERE is_pressure_hunting = true
ORDER BY tagsn, logtime;
`;
msg.payload = sql;
return msg;

msg.payload = `
INSERT INTO tb_equipment_alarm_report (
    alarm_start_time, tagsn, sitename, facilitytype,
    alarm_msg, alarm_status, alarm_category, alarm_severity,
    is_false_alarm, false_alarm_notes
)
SELECT
    NOW(),
    t.tagsn,
    t.sitename,
    t.facilitytype,
    '통신이상 ' || t.cnt || '개 태그 감지',
    '진행중',
    '통신',
    CASE WHEN t.cnt >= 3 THEN '경고' ELSE '주의' END,
    'N',
    '자동 감지'
FROM (
    SELECT
        FIRST_VALUE(ti.tagsn) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ti.sitename, ti.facilitytype
            ORDER BY ti.tagsn
        ) AS tagsn,
        ti.sitename,
        ti.facilitytype,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ti.sitename, ti.facilitytype) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ti.sitename, ti.facilitytype
            ORDER BY ti.tagsn
        ) AS rn
    FROM tb_tag_info ti
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT r.val
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        WHERE r.tagsn = ti.tagsn
          AND r.logtime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
        ORDER BY r.logtime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON TRUE
    WHERE ti.tagtype = 'Digital Input'
      AND ti.datainfo LIKE '%통신이상%'
      AND r.val = 1
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM tb_equipment_alarm_report ar
      WHERE ar.sitename = t.sitename
        AND ar.facilitytype = t.facilitytype
        AND ar.alarm_category = '통신'
        AND ar.alarm_end_time IS NULL
  );
`;
return msg;
